title: Sopra Steria UK is a Microsoft and Salesforce house excluded on a mechanical v2 rescore
content:
Sopra Steria UK carries Microsoft and Salesforce as its recorded platforms, against public, banking and insurance verticals. Its do-not-pitch tier came from a mechanical rescore of a provisional v2 tail entry on size and slot occupancy, with no v3 evidence pass and an OSS-portfolio screen still outstanding.

The row is most informative read against its Dutch sibling, which shares the recorded stack but adds warnings about unseparable revenue and an unstable org chart. The UK entry has neither, which means the two national rows were assessed independently even though they belong to one group — and that the caveats on the Dutch row are specifically about its integration, not about Sopra Steria generally.

On its own the UK row asserts little: two large proprietary platforms occupying the slot, and a tier derived from scale. Both point the same way, but neither was verified against the firm's actual portfolio.
